noun_definition: Web refers to the user interface of the application where inconsistencies in text alignment are observed, specifically in tooltips displaying usernames.

lhn refers to the "left-hand navigation" area of the app where user display names and tooltips are presented, specifically highlighting an inconsistency in the text alignment of usernames in tooltips.

Inconsistency bug refers to the misalignment of the username text in the tooltip for the three dots, which is not centered as expected, contrasting with the centered display of the same username in other tooltips.
Dot text refers to the three dots that represent a long username in a tooltip, which is expected to be center-aligned like the display name in the same context.
